what_this_is: Sentences of two pages of Global Forest Watch (World Resources Institute), registered on 10 October 2026: its developer help page and its guide to API keys. Each page carries the provider's whole help text. This file adds to provider_cautions.json of 9 October 2026, which is not changed; where the two repeat a figure (the errors of commission and omission), this file's sentence is the help text's and that file's is the dataset record's
how_a_page_is_read: the page source with the escapes \u003c, \u003e, \u0026, \n and \" turned into their characters, HTML entities turned into characters, tags taken out, and runs of spaces and non-breaking spaces made one space; the quotation marks are the page's own

cautions_about_the_data.name: accuracy_varies
cautions_about_the_data.text: The accuracy of the data displayed on GNW is variable across datasets, and through space and time.
stands_in: the provider's guide to API keys

cautions_about_the_data.name: errors_of_commission_and_omission
cautions_about_the_data.text: In summary, the authors evaluated the overall prevalence of false positives (commission errors) in the original dataset at 13%, and the prevalence of false negatives (omission errors) at 12%, though the accuracy varies by biome and thus may be higher or lower in any particular location.
stands_in: the provider's guide to API keys

cautions_about_the_data.name: sub_tropical_areas
cautions_about_the_data.text: Specifically, sub-tropical areas have the lowest accuracies (around 20% for commission and omission errors).
stands_in: the provider's guide to API keys

cautions_about_the_data.name: smallholder_landscapes
cautions_about_the_data.text: The model often misses disturbances in smallholder landscapes, resulting in lower accuracy of the data in locations such as sub-Saharan Africa, where this type of disturbance is more common.
stands_in: the provider's guide to API keys

cautions_about_the_data.name: method_changed_in_2015
cautions_about_the_data.text: For example, in 2015, the integration of Landsat 8 satellite data and updates to the loss detection algorithm from UMD resulted in better capturing of small-scale loss.
stands_in: the provider's guide to API keys

cautions_about_the_data.name: tree_cover_is_not_forest
cautions_about_the_data.text: Accordingly, “tree cover” and “forest” should not be used interchangeably.
stands_in: the provider's guide to API keys

cautions_about_the_data.name: loss_is_not_deforestation
cautions_about_the_data.text: “Tree cover loss” refers to the removal or mortality of tree cover and can be due to a variety of factors, including mechanical harvesting, fire, disease or storm damage. As such, “loss” does not equate to deforestation.
stands_in: the provider's guide to API keys

on_api_keys.name: some_endpoints_require_a_key
on_api_keys.text: Some endpoints require users to include an API key with their request

on_api_keys.name: most_requests_need_a_key
on_api_keys.text: To make most requests to the GFW Data API using third-party applications (e.g., scripts or websites), you need an API key.
stands_in: the provider's guide to API keys
